newsitem.title: USA: N.Y. police nab car carrying 573 pounds of cocaine.
newsitem.headline: N.Y. police nab car carrying 573 pounds of cocaine.

text.p: New York City Police found $5 million of cocaine Wednesday when the searched the backseat and trunk of a car they stopped for failing to signal a right turn, officials said.
Police said officers stopped a 1996 Taurus in upper Manhattan when the driver, John Tanayo, 30, of Queens, did not turn on his turn signal.
They observed cocaine on the backseat then searched the trunk to discover a total of 260 kilograms (573 pounds) of the drug, police said.
